title: Pan-Seared Fish with Creamy Kenyan Sauce
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish served with a rich and creamy Kenyan-inspired sauce. This recipe is perfect for a romantic dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Sauce (Coconut milk, yogurt, garlic, ginger)

instructions: 2. Season the cod fillets with fish seasoning and poke salt.
3. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Sear the cod fillets for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Transfer the pan-seared cod to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, prepare the Kenyan sauce by combining coconut milk, yogurt, garlic, and ginger in a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth.
6. To serve, place a pan-seared cod fillet on each plate and spoon the Kenyan sauce over the top. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with lemon wedges on the side.
